author: FranS189

title: Wine tourism at Bodegas Salado
text: Wine tourism in Seville with @naturandatours. We visited the @bodegassalado in Umbrete (Seville) founded in 1810 by Don Ramón Salado. Bodegas salado has always remained in the hands of the family, currently in the sixth generation. In their Las Yeguas estate, located in Aljarafe, they have been cultivating the native Garrido Fino grape for decades. With it they have made the first Sevillian sparkling wine "umbretum", awarded as the best wine in Seville. title: Thoroughly enjoyable
text: We had a lovely time with our wine tour, despite it being the warmest part of summer. Transport was provided and we had a lovely tour with Pedro where he talked us through the process or making the wine, the new sparkling wine they’re making and answering any questions we had along the way with exceptional English! We then got to taste a few of their wines and purchase some to take home. We then enjoyed some lunch with our guide Patricia who drove us, supplied lunch and gave us a few wines to sample whilst we were able to sit and chat with the others on the tour! title: The legend of Pablo!
text:
